_about: Ours, not a design copy. Vincent at the Route 1 stream bank (29,12), the Glimmerwell shift at Juniper's east-road camp (juniper_east), the Keeper night shift with Keeper Amos (lanternAsk), and the report that sets story.rdv_done, which opens the built side pick. No new room, town or route.
_placeholders: Every line here is PLACEHOLDER for June (D1410). Vincent's title is PLACEHOLDER (D1398). No line names the chip, the Tuning or an implant (CHIP_SECRECY).

rdv_meet: So Ilse sent you. Good. No poles down here. The wire can't hear the water.
I wear their colours, holder. I don't wear all their plans.
Both sides want you. So both will open a door. Walk through each one. Look at what they don't show you.
Vincent presses a card into your hand. GUEST, in honey letters.
Juniper's crew camps on the east road out of Fernbrook. Show her that card. They're always short of hands.
Amos walks the lamp round after dark. Walk it with him. Ilse's note goes on the Commander's desk.
I'll wait here. They'd know my face. Come back and tell me what you saw.
rdv_wait: Juniper's crew, done. Now Amos. He walks the lamp round from the Lantern House.
Amos's round, done. Now Juniper's crew, on the east road out of Fernbrook.
One shift with each side. Juniper on the east road, Amos at the Lantern House. Then come back.
shift_g: A Guest pass! Wonderful. We're short of hands. Crates, please!
You pack Comfort Lamps into crates. One, two, three. Every lid gets a honey tag: FREE.
A ledger lies open on the cart. OLD SEALS: 3 bought. Fair Acorns.
A crew Walkling trots back from a free check-up. Juniper calls its name. It looks up. A beat late.
A little sleepy after a check-up. Totally normal! Brighter by nature.
The cart's back door is shut. A plate on it: PARTNERS ONLY.
Partners only, sweetie. One day, maybe! It's a partnership.
You pack the last crate. Juniper hums along.
Lovely work! Same time tomorrow? Have a bright day!
shift_k: Walk the lamp round with me? The officers like company after dark.
Evening. You walk with Amos from lamp to lamp. The officers nod him through.
Hall post next. The Commander's desk is by the cordon. That note of yours goes there, I'm told.
You set Ilse's note on the field desk. Under it lies a long sheet.
FERNBROOK ROLL. Holders with Seals, ready for call-up. By order of High Charity. Copies to Wardens: none.
The newest line, in fresh ink: {name}.
...A roll. Ilse never saw this, did she? I'll keep it to myself. For now.
You lay the note back on top and walk on.
Lamps are lit. That's the round. Get some rest, holder.
rdv_report: You're back. Well? What did they keep in the back room?
You tell him about the roll, and the newest name on it.
That roll was a war list once. The call-up law was never struck out. Someone has dusted it off.
Tanks for a crate dispute. A list of every holder with a Seal. That's not keeping. That's mustering.
You tell him about the ledger, and the Walkling that answered late.
They don't buy old Seals to hang on a wall. Ask what a free check-up costs.
My Walkling went in for a free check-up last spring. She still comes when I call. A beat late.
You tell him about the ledger, and the Walkling that answered late.
They don't buy old Seals to hang on a wall. Ask what a free check-up costs.
My Walkling went in for a free check-up last spring. She still comes when I call. A beat late.
You tell him about the roll, and the newest name on it.
That roll was a war list once. The call-up law was never struck out. Someone has dusted it off.
Tanks for a crate dispute. A list of every holder with a Seal. That's not keeping. That's mustering.
You listened more than you packed. Hold on to that.
You get things done. Make sure you know what for.
You looked. That's all I asked.
I won't pick for you. Fen's at the orchard gate.
Vincent climbs the bank and is gone.
